title: 第二十一章散修之家
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
老槐头靠着歪脖子槐树打盹，一根磨得发亮的木杖搁在膝盖上。听见脚步声，他眼皮都没抬。在这蹲了十几年，什么人都见过，两个脚步虚浮、体内空空的凡人，不值得他睁眼。

    沈君壁走到他面前，站定。没催，就站在那里，等了片刻，不急不躁，然后他开口了。

    “老丈，可是鱼头？马赖介绍的。”

    老槐头睁眼了。“鱼头”这个称呼只有散修里的熟客知道。马赖是那个专门给人销赃的赖子，给他介绍过好几笔生意。他上下打量沈君壁，凡人，但说话的语气不像凡人。

    “马赖人呢？有些日子没见他了。不过呢，凡人是不带的，要带我是冒风险的，一人五颗下品灵石。”

    沈君壁没有接这句话。他从怀里掏出灵石，托在掌心里，往前递了半寸。“带我们进坊市。市场价，一人两颗。”

    老槐头没拿灵石。他看着那四颗下品灵石，嘴角的火泡在晨光里格外明显，半个月没开张了，喉咙干得发紧，是长期吃劣质辟谷丹落下的毛病。但他还是摇了摇头。

    沈君壁把灵石往前递了半寸。“我们是去投奔韩家商铺的。”

    老槐头的手指停在木杖上。韩家，刚灭了沈家满门，在云霄阁扶持下如日中天的韩家。坊市里最大的丹药铺就是韩家开的，前几天还招了一批散修当护卫。他沉默了一会儿，没问“你跟韩家什么关系”，也没问“你姓什么”。在坊市蹲了十几年，学到的第一条规矩就是别打听不该打听的事。

    “韩家商铺的掌柜是谁？”

    “韩文渊。”沈君壁答得极快，像在说自己亲叔叔的名字。

    老槐头又看了一眼侯紫。“这个呢？”

    “族人。”

    老槐头哼了一声，伸出手，把沈君壁托着灵石的手指轻轻合上。“先收着。到了再给。”他拄着木杖站起来，转身往槐树林深处走去。木杖点在树根上，每一下都恰好落在某条看不见的缝隙里。他走路极快，完全不像瘸腿的人，时而绕树三圈，时而退两步进三步，时而侧身穿过来时根本没看到的树缝。

    “跟着我的脚印走。别碰树干，别抬头看树冠。”

    沈君壁问为什么。

    “碰了树干，树会记住你的气味。抬头看树冠，你会看到不想看的东西。”老槐头的声音从前面飘过来，木杖点地的节奏丝毫没有放慢，“有个散修抬头看了一眼，出来的时候眼睛瞎了。他说树冠里有眼睛在看他。我可从不抬头看。”

    沈君壁不再问了。侯紫跟在后面，张开手掌接风。风变了，不是林间风，是一股从地下往上冒的阴风，带着腐朽的甜味。他低头一看，脚边有一截白骨，半埋在落叶里，已经分不清是兽骨还是人骨。他注意到老槐头的木杖从不碰树干，只点树根，而且在每个转弯处都会停顿半息，像是等某种看不见的东西确认他的身份。

    走了约莫半个时辰，老槐头停下来。前方是一片更加密集的槐树林，树干上刻着密密麻麻的符文，已经风化了大半，只剩残痕。他用木杖在地上画了条线。

    “线那边就是坊市。进去之后三件事记好：第一，别盯着别人的手看。第二，别在同一个摊位前站超过一炷香。”

    沈君壁把灵石递过去。老槐头接过，掂了掂，揣进怀里。然后他转过身，拄着木杖往回走。

    侯紫在背后忽然开口：“老丈，生意咋样？”

    老槐头脚步顿了一下，没回头。

    “半个月没开张了吧。”侯紫的声音不紧不慢，像是在聊家常，“你在这蹲了这么久，难得碰到两个肯付灵石的凡人，市场价四颗灵石，你开口要十颗，其实你本来想要更多，但你自己也知道，再多我们就走了。”

    老槐头转过身，看着侯紫。侯紫嘿嘿一笑，手指在袖子里搓了一下。
content_en:
The old locust boy took a nap against the crooked locust tree, with a polished wooden stick resting on his knees.He didn't even raise his eyelids when he heard the footsteps.After squatting here for more than ten years, he has seen everyone. Two mortals with empty steps and empty bodies are not worthy of opening his eyes.

Shen Junbi walked up to him and stood still.Without urging, he just stood there and waited for a moment, taking his time, and then he spoke.

"My father-in-law, you are the fish head? It was introduced by Ma Lai."

The old man opened his eyes.The name "Fish Head" is only known by regular customers in casual cultivators.Ma Lai was the scoundrel who specialized in selling stolen goods to others and had introduced him to several businesses.He looked Shen Junbi up and down, he was a mortal, but his tone of voice didn't sound like a mortal.

"Where's the Marais? I haven't seen him in some days. But, mortals don't take them with them. It's risky to take me with you. I have five low-grade spiritual stones per person."

Shen Junbi did not answer this sentence.He took out the spirit stone from his arms, held it in his palm, and held it half an inch forward."Take us into the market. The market price is two pills per person."

Lao Huaitou didn't take the spirit stone.He looked at the four low-grade spiritual stones. The bubbles at the corners of his mouth were particularly obvious in the morning light. He had not opened his mouth for half a month, and his throat was dry and tight. This was a problem caused by long-term consumption of low-quality Bigu Pills.But he shook his head.

Shen Junbi handed the spirit stone half an inch forward."We are going to the Han family's store."

Lao Huaitou's fingers stopped on the wooden stick.The Han family, which had just wiped out the entire Shen family, was flourishing with the support of Yunxiao Pavilion.The largest elixir shop in Fang City is opened by the Han family, and a group of casual cultivators were recruited as guards a few days ago.He was silent for a while and did not ask "What is your relationship with the Han family" or "What is your surname?"After more than ten years of squatting in Fangshi, the first rule I learned is not to ask about things you shouldn't ask about.

"Who is the shopkeeper of Han's store?"

"Han Wenyuan." Shen Junbi answered very quickly, as if he was talking about his own uncle's name.

Lao Huaitou glanced at Hou Zi again."What about this?"

"Clan members."

Lao Huaitou snorted, stretched out his hand, and gently closed Shen Junbi's fingers holding the spirit stone."Keep it first. Give it to me when it arrives." He stood up with a wooden stick, turned around and walked deeper into the locust forest.The wooden stick hit the root of the tree, and each stroke landed exactly in an invisible gap.He walked very fast, not like a lame person at all. Sometimes he circled the tree three times, sometimes he took two steps back and took three steps forward, and sometimes he walked sideways through a gap in the tree that he didn't see at all.

"Follow my footsteps. Don't touch the tree trunks, don't look up at the canopy."

Shen Junbi asked why.

"If you touch the trunk, the tree will remember your scent. If you look up at the crown of the tree, you will see things you don't want to see." Old Sophora Tou's voice drifted from the front, and the rhythm of the stick tapping the ground did not slow down at all. "A casual cultivator looked up and came out blind. He said that there were eyes in the crown of the tree looking at him. I never look up."

Shen Junbi stopped asking.Hou Zi followed behind, opening her palms to catch the wind.The wind changed. It was not the wind in the forest, but a dark wind rising from the ground, carrying a decadent sweetness.He looked down and saw a piece of white bone at his feet, half buried in the fallen leaves. He couldn't tell whether it was an animal bone or a human bone.He noticed that Lao Huaitou's wooden stick never touched the trunk of the tree, but only touched the roots. He would pause for a moment at every turn, as if waiting for something invisible to confirm his identity.

After walking for about half an hour, Lao Huaitou stopped.Ahead is a denser locust forest, with dense runes carved on the tree trunks. Most of them have been weathered, leaving only traces.He drew a line on the ground with his stick.

"On the other side of the line is Fangshi. Remember three things after entering: first, don't stare at other people's hands. Second, don't stand in front of the same stall for more than one stick of incense."

Shen Junbi handed over the spirit stone.Lao Huaitou took it, weighed it, and put it in his arms.Then he turned around and walked back with his wooden stick.

Hou Zi suddenly said from behind: "My father-in-law, how is the business?"

Lao Huaitou paused for a moment and did not look back.

"It hasn't been open for half a month." Hou Zi's voice was unhurried, as if he was talking about daily life, "You have been here for so long, and it is rare to meet two mortals who are willing to pay for spiritual stones. The market price is four spiritual stones, and you asked for ten. In fact, you originally wanted more, but you also know that if more, we will leave."

Lao Huaitou turned around and looked at Hou Zi.Hou Zi chuckled and rubbed his fingers in his sleeves.
